nonClaims: This is not a global detector inventory.
Repository presence does not prove a detector is live, current or complete.
Absence of an exact binding is UNKNOWN coverage, not evidence of no compromise.

targetClasses.reason: Historical Attack Flow/ATT&CK persistence evidence is not current local telemetry and cannot establish present detector coverage.
Generic telemetry capability exists, but this census found no exact DW09 compromise/persistence detector binding for Linux Runtime.
Runtime recovery evidence is not equivalent to compromise/persistence detector coverage.
Browser-security detector coverage artifacts are owner/target specific and cannot be reused as Exchange or Runtime compromise evidence.
